response.rationale: The item is a final-sale gift card (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. The standard 30-day window (RET-007) does not apply because it requires final_sale == False, and RET-020 does not apply since the item is not defective. Thus the return is ineligible regardless of the customer's change of mind.
